detailed_description: The Markdown to PDF converter renders Markdown as sanitized HTML in the browser, shows a live preview, and opens a print window so you can save the result as a PDF with your browser's print dialog. It supports GitHub Flavored Markdown parsing through marked, including headings, lists, tables, code blocks, blockquotes, horizontal rules, inline code, bold, and italic text. You can set the document title, choose 10 to 16 pt font size, and select A4, Letter, or Legal page size before printing.
usage_steps: Enter or paste your Markdown content
Set the document title for the print window
Select A4, Letter, or Legal page size
Click Generate PDF and use the browser print dialog to save as PDF
usage_examples: Preview Markdown documentation and save it through the browser print dialog
Create a printable draft from Markdown notes
Prepare a PDF copy of a README-style document
